headline: Nevish Line Stays Alight as Callahans Passage Rejoins the Storm
war_summary: The Nevish Line refuses to cool: ten flag events in the past two hours, fifty-nine across the day, with the district still split five Colonial posts to three Warden and Grief Mother and The Scrying Belt the busiest grounds. Linn Mercy logged the newest flag movement of any front as this edition went to press, its day's tally near forty events and casualties still running heavy about Rotdust and Outwich Ranch. Callahans Passage has hardened into battle once more: Crumbling Post drew sixteen events in a day, and the region's hourly losses now top a thousand on each side. The Weathered Expanse, consolidated under Warden flags in our last report, has gone five hours without a base event, though its casualty ledgers continue to fill. Mooring County and Marban Hollow have raised no flags since late morning and midday respectively, yet Mooring's losses mount at a quickening pace. Clahstra likewise bleeds heavily without a post changing hands, while Stlican Shelf's flag work remains confined to Briar. It is day 772 of the war; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
